case.caveats: ASSAY FORMAT: this is a TaqMan assay; the internal MGB probe (CTGATCATTGGAAACCT, Table 1) sits inside the amplicon and does not affect the 96 bp primer-to-primer product. SPLICING: the paper explicitly states exon-exon borders "were not considered" when designing the S20 and GAPDH assays, so 96 bp is established on this cDNA/EST template only - whether the primers also amplify from genomic DNA, and at what size, is simply NOT established by the paper (this is different from a known intron-spanning assay). TEMPLATE: BU693999.1 is an Atlantic salmon eye cDNA library EST (796 bp), i.e. cDNA, not genomic. In-silico check: forward matches once at 230, reverse site once ending at 325; product 230..325 = 96 bp, exact, no alternative products.
case.citation: Olsvik PA, Lie KK, Jordal AEO, Nilsen TO, Hordvik I. Evaluation of potential reference genes in real-time RT-PCR studies of Atlantic salmon. BMC Mol Biol. 2005;6:21. doi:10.1186/1471-2199-6-21. PMID 16293192; PMCID PMC1314898.
case.element: Non-TE control assay. Glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase (GAPDH) evaluated as a real-time RT-PCR reference gene.
case.loci_justification: The pair flanks one locus on the cited template: a single insertion site, a single excision site, or a single transcript. A second product on this template would be an off-target prediction.
case.name: Atlantic salmon GAPDH TaqMan reference-gene assay
case.where_in_paper: Table 1 ("TaqMan assays used to evaluate potential reference genes in Atlantic salmon"), row GAPDH: "Forward primer" and "Reverse primer" columns, and 96 in the "Amplicon size (bp)" column. The template accession is given in Methods, "Design of PCR primers and TaqMan probes": "The mRNA sequences encoding S20 ribosomal protein and GAPDH were obtained from GenBank accession numbers BG936672 and BU693999, respectively (exon-exon borders were not considered)." The same section states "Amplified PCR products of all actual cDNAs were sequenced to ensure that the correct mRNA sequences were quantified."
case.worked_prediction_note: The entry records a worked prediction — a coordinate range, an in-silico check, or a sequence-derived length — so the expected answer was written down before the engine ran. The published size remains external, but this case was not scored blind.
